## Objective and roadmap stage
Link the capability and docs/ROADMAP.md; identify a demonstrable result.

## Owner and reviewer
B0 belongs to Ahmed. Leave every downstream owner/reviewer unassigned until Ahmed chooses them.

## Dependencies and readiness
Downstream implementation requires accepted B0 handoff plus the specific stable inputs/access. Distinguish preparation from real integration acceptance.

## Deliverables
- [ ] List cohesive implementation steps; use checklists instead of a ticket per function.

## Acceptance and reproduction
- [ ] Observable behavior, relevant tests and failure cases
- [ ] Fresh-checkout artifact fetch/run/restore and independent reproduction
- [ ] Actual versions, metrics, failed cases and limitations when applicable

## Requirements / historical traceability
Map original CDC requirements and superseded issues. Do not drop required fine-tuning or any comparison.

## Definition of Done
Follow CDC §14: branch/PR, relevant checks and passing hosted CI, secrets review, assigned-reviewer handling under the advisory-review policy, affected docs/current stage journal and reproducible experiment evidence. A planning migration is not implementation acceptance.
